note: Provenance classes. Every number in this repository carries one.

classes.MODELLED: Computed from documented inputs + stated assumption. Reproducible arithmetic.
classes.SIMULATED: Monte Carlo distribution over stated priors. Seeded. A range, never a point.
classes.BOUNDED: Logical bound where no point estimate is defensible.
classes.PRIOR: Belief with explicit probability, no evidence yet. Paired with the observation that moves it.

rule: A prediction is legitimate. A fabricated observation is not. No cell in this repository is filled with an invented quote, respondent or count.
forbidden_list_note: The banned-phrase list lives in data_p35_estimates.FORBIDDEN_CLAIMS and is deliberately NOT reproduced here - emitting it would make every grep of the repository trip on the guard definition itself.
